external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor node installed on a customer site and publishing readings to the device gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway
external_entities.notes: The nodes are outside the organisation's physical control. The pre-shared key is per fleet, not per device.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.notes: The source does not state what authentication the console has, if any.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views telemetry dashboards from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: A customer associated with an installed sensor node and its customer data.
external_entities.source_excerpt: to find out which customer the node belongs to

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker running on GKE that accepts sensor readings from nodes and forwards them to Pub/Sub.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE and expose to the internet

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer in the analytics network that consumes readings and writes them to the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

processes.name: dashboards
processes.description: Dashboards used by fleet operators to view telemetry over BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used by the gateway to check the device key and determine which customer a node belongs to.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A Pub/Sub service onto which the gateway forwards accepted readings for consumption by the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing site addresses and occupancy patterns from the sensor fleet.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: firmware bucket
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket from which sensor nodes poll firmware images. The bucket is publicly readable.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not state whether nodes verify a signature before installing an image.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.description: A sensor node publishes readings to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.description: The device gateway looks up device information, checks the key, and finds the associated customer in the device registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.description: The device gateway forwards accepted readings onto Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer consumes readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.description: A sensor node polls the firmware bucket for a new image and installs what it finds.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image and install what they find
data_flows.notes: The source does not state whether nodes check a signature on the image before installing it.

data_flows.name: service console
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over its local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state what authentication the console has, if any.

data_flows.name: view dashboards
data_flows.description: A fleet operator views dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.

data_flows.name: read telemetry
data_flows.description: The dashboards read telemetry from BigQuery.

trust_boundaries.name: customer site
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-controlled site where sensor nodes are installed and field technicians service them.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: sensor nodes installed on customer sites

trust_boundaries.name: GKE
trust_boundaries.description: The GKE environment on which the device gateway runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE

trust_boundaries.name: analytics network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the telemetry normalizer runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which fleet operators view dashboards.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake's data is confidential.
assumptions.basis: The lake contains site addresses and occupancy patterns and is explicitly described as customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake holds personally identifying customer data.
assumptions.basis: The lake contains site addresses and occupancy patterns associated with customers.

assumptions.assumption: The device gateway presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: The device gateway is described as an MQTT broker, which is a non-web broker interface.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry normalizer presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: The telemetry normalizer is described as a Python consumer rather than a web application.
